Monica — thanks for the context. A few quick points from commercial:

- For a 3-month regulated POC that cannot use shared hosts, the lowest-friction option is a Dedicated VPC deployment (reserved capacity with VPC peering) rather than full Private/on-prem. Dedicated gives us the isolation they need and is reversible after 3 months.
- Standard surcharge for Dedicated VPC peering + single-tenant routing is typically 18-22% on top of hosted rates, plus a minimal setup fee (we can waive setup fee in strategic deals).
- One-time onboarding credit: AE-level discretionary is $10k. Anything above that requires VP signoff; credits > $50k require CFO signoff.

If SignalWave expects to convert to a 12-month committed contract post-POC, we can be more flexible (reduce surcharge, larger credit). If not, we should be conservative.

Please attach the SOW and expected token/throughput forecast. I'll need estimated monthly spend to run the rate math.

Karthik

Team — I support the Dedicated VPC approach for a 3-month POC. For strategic healthcare logos like SignalWave we should be pragmatic on setup fee and onboarding credits to remove friction. Proposed path:

1) Approve Dedicated VPC for the POC with a 15% surcharge (we can absorb part of the standard uplift for conversion risk).
2) Approve a one-time onboarding credit of up to $25k (requires my signoff, >$25k needs Markus).
3) Require a written conversion intent: SignalWave to commit to a 12-month minimum term within 30 days of POC completion at pre-agreed baseline rates to unlock a rebate that offsets some surcharge.

Monica/Dylan — please ask procurement to provide expected monthly token spend and a short SOW. Also attach the SignalWave_Security_Checklist and the draft MSA redlines; legal will triage any gating items.

Marissa

Monica / Marissa — quick CFO note and sign-off conditions.

I reviewed the ask and the proposed concessions. I approve the following under these conditions:

- Approve Dedicated VPC path with a capped effective discount such that gross margin does not fall below 55% on expected POC consumption.
- Approve onboarding credit up to $40,000 (we will fund up to $25k from Sales discretionary and up to additional $15k conditional on an executed conversion LOI).
- No reduction in baseline per-token rates without a signed 12-month commitment. The 12-month commitment must include minimum monthly consumption floors or fixed monthly fees to protect unit economics.
- Any changes to MSA retention or logging obligations that materially increase operational costs must be triaged by Security & Legal; exceptions are not automatic.

Monica — please confirm expected monthly spend and attach the SOW and MSA redlines. If SignalWave signs an LOI to convert, Finance will process the additional $15k contribution.
